Simple APIs for writing HPACK header entries into an HTTP/2 ring buffer.

# Purpose
This header file defines small inline helpers to write HPACK header fields into an `fd_h2_rbuf_t` transmit buffer. It includes a generic [`fd_hpack_wr_varint`](<#fd_hpack_wr_varint>) encoder for HPACK integer values, then uses it to build common HTTP/2 headers such as `:method: POST`, `:scheme`, `:path`, `te: trailers`, `user-agent`, `authorization: Bearer ...`, and `:authority`. The code uses indexed and literal HPACK forms, and it checks buffer space before each write. It is a simple serialization helper for HTTP/2 header generation.
